propositions: When signing_key is configured but author_id is falsy, _apply_authorship returns silently without logging, allowing unsigned writes to go undetected; AC3 requires a WARNING log naming the event uuid, the ticket, and which input (author_id or signing_key) was missing.

fsck reports authorship only as a single store-wide uncounted tally, making it impossible to detect when one env writes 0% signed events; AC2 requires per-env UNSIGNED_ENV findings counted in issue_count and issues[] json output for any env that signs nothing or authors everything Unknown, but only if that env wrote at or after the store's first signed event.

Four existing envs have 0% signed-rate but are dormant (last event predates first store signed-event); the adoption gate in AC2 prevents false-positive reporting on dormant pre-signing envs while still catching active unsigned writers like beb1's env b2b5c498.

EnvAuthorshipTally new module feeds from Check 1's already-parsed JSON payloads with no extra filesystem pass; unsigned_env is not added to _STRUCTURED_KINDS to avoid mis-parsing the env_id head as a ticket_id.
